name: Katsuragi Shura
source:
2nd year university student.
Likes: Sun Bathing
Dislikes: Spicy Food

The protagonist's home tutor, he's a friend of a cousin of hers.
Gentle and sociable, he's a kind and considerate person.
He tends to do things at his own pace and it's hard to know what he's thinking.
